column3: “mocking” renders “metsaheq” (laughing, playing), from the root of “Isaac”; the Greek adds “with Isaac her son.”
the order of the Hebrew leaves unclear whether the boy was also put on her shoulder.
the Greek reads “and the child lifted up his voice and wept.”
“an archer” renders “a shooter, an archer (of the bow).”
“my posterity” renders a rare word, “my descendants.”
